text: Hello. This chat box runs only on this computer, at 127.0.0.1, and it does not use the internet.
D-RAYL Chat Box v1 is a local plumbing demo. It has no infer engine yet. It answers from stored grains in the sand pit and from memory of what helped last time.
Mate is the desktop face of CID: a black screen with aqua eyes.
The planned Main CID brain is a Raspberry Pi 5 with 16GB of memory.
A sentence starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop.
D-RAYL is a vocabulary of 65,000 symbols sitting above the weights and the sand pit. The decoder is the translator between raw numeric output and that symbol set.
The chat box binds only to 127.0.0.1 (this computer). It does not accept connections from the network, and it makes no outbound internet calls.
Sleep mode tidies the sand pit: grains that get used a lot are promoted to the hot tier, unused ones are demoted to cold, and protected grains are not demoted.
Every reply is also saved as a candidate grain in the staging folder. Nothing is added to the sand pit automatically. You can review candidates and promote the ones that pass the compliance gate.
